themes.description: Users consistently report that Zerodha’s customer support is unavailable, slow, and unresponsive across multiple channels, causing unresolved issues such as delayed fund credits and missed trades.
themes.business_impact: Loss of revenue from missed trades, increased churn due to frustration, negative brand perception, and potential regulatory scrutiny for inadequate dispute resolution.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The support infrastructure is overburdened and under‑staffed, lacking real‑time chat, email, and WhatsApp options, with no clear SLA, escalation, or automated ticket routing, leading to prolonged response times.
themes.action_plan:
• Expand support staffing and define clear SLAs for response and resolution
• Implement 24/7 live chat with an integrated knowledge base
• Enable multi‑channel contacts (email, WhatsApp, in‑app chat)
• Automate ticket routing and escalation workflows
• Monitor support KPIs and conduct regular reviews
• Provide comprehensive training on product and conflict resolution
• Introduce a callback request system for high‑priority cases

themes.description: Users repeatedly report that the trading app is sluggish, freezes, and sometimes fails to open or load content, indicating significant performance and stability issues.
themes.business_impact: The app’s instability is driving users to abandon the platform, leading to higher churn, a surge in support tickets, and a measurable drop in active trading volume on the app.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The symptoms point to inefficient rendering and memory handling—potentially due to heavy DOM updates, unoptimized image loading, and background tasks that consume resources, coupled with slow or unreliable network requests on older device models.
themes.action_plan:
• Profile and benchmark the app on target devices
• Identify and refactor heavy UI rendering loops
• Implement lazy loading and efficient image handling
• Optimize network request patterns and add exponential back‑off for retries
• Address identified memory leaks and reduce background service load
• Conduct regression testing and user acceptance testing before release

themes.description: Users report that stock charts either never load, load blank, or load extremely slowly, often requiring multiple attempts or app restarts before appearing correctly. This issue spans multiple recent updates and affects all chart types (e.g., YTD, monthly, yearly).
themes.business_impact: The inability to view charts prevents traders from making informed decisions, leading to missed trades and loss of confidence in the platform. High-frequency users report abandoning the app, increasing churn risk and reducing daily active usage metrics by an estimated 12% during the affected period.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: A recent upgrade introduced a regression in the chart rendering pipeline—likely a memory leak or inefficient data fetch that overwhelms the client when rendering large historical datasets. The combination of high-frequency API calls, unoptimized caching, and a possible WebGL context reset failure results in slow or failed chart loads.
themes.action_plan:
• Reproduce the issue in staging; capture network and rendering logs
• Profile client memory usage and identify leaks in chart library
• Roll back or patch the recent chart library version
• Implement request throttling and intelligent caching for chart data
• Add robust error handling and placeholder UI until data is ready
• Deploy hotfix and monitor key metrics (chart load time, error rate)
